evidence_paraphrase: The original Amgen offer defines the covered security as Five Prime common stock and identifies its Nasdaq symbol FPRX. Section 6 explicitly reports that same Nasdaq security's quarterly trading history throughout 2018, 2019 and all four quarters of 2020, continuing into March 2021. The subject security history covers the required 2020 lookback; acquisition terms and later prices are not feature inputs.
limitations: Actual review and capture occurred in September 2026; this is retrospective identity adjudication, not a contemporaneous archived review.
The archived bytes are the actual web-tool representation, not original SEC HTML. Immutable accession-specific SEC URLs identify the original disclosures.

The interval establishes reviewed common-security identity and exchange history; it does not assert uninterrupted executable liquidity, complete corporate-action coverage or daily absence of trading halts.
Post-observation filing text is used only to reconstruct historical security identity. No offer prices, acquisition terms or later financial disclosures are market-feature values.
publication_time_limitation: Document dateline/signature was reviewed; an independently accessible filing-index publication or acceptance time was not obtained. No publication clock is backdated from this review.
review_scope: Retrospective same-issuer common-equity listing and ticker identity for the bounded market-feature lookback, using explicit historical trading disclosures. Not a new outcome or pending-transaction review.
